SPEEDIEST FREEKS

KULT OF SPEED STRATAGEN

Speed Freeks ace often just blurs of vehicular mayhen

that prove difficult to land a blow on.
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy
unit targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit

TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an
unmodified hit roll of 1-3
